summary: Reach agent-pane thread headings by keyboard: Ctrl+Up/Down walk tools then threads, Ctrl+Enter expands or collapses the focused thread

replay.detail: No durable data is replayed; moving focus queues no thread action.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes.

rules.detail: Thread authority, fences and mutation rules are unchanged; the thread keys still need the same grants.

compatibility.detail: In an agent conversation Ctrl+Up/Down now move focus through the tool blocks and then the thread headings below them, in the order they are drawn, also from the message box or a thread reply box, which let go of the keys and keep their drafts. The focused heading gets the ▌ gutter even when collapsed, Ctrl+Enter expands or collapses it without moving the keys into its reply box, and the thread keys (alt+p z n v) act on it. Clicking a tool or a thread moves the single focus the same way.

manual.detail: In fractal tui open an agent conversation with threads, type a draft, press Ctrl+Down until a thread heading shows ▌ (the footer says Thread i of n focused), press Ctrl+Enter twice to expand and collapse it, then type a letter: it joins the kept draft. ? help lists the keys.

recovery.detail: Presentation and keyboard routing only; no daemon state, pairings or drafts change.
